category_title: Low-attaining students developing fraction concepts through physical measurement with manipulatives
scenario_title: Connecting physical measurement to fraction names
minimal_context: The student is using red and brown Cuisenaire rods to determine fraction names during a mathematics lesson.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please use these red and brown Cuisenaire rods to work on your fractions.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Places the red rods beside the brown rod) What it is. I'm kind of measuring it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What are you trying to measure?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: See if it's a quarter or not. Because I went like this... (moves small red rods along the longer rod).

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: How would you know if it is a quarter?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: An ordinary guess. I was happy because that was pretty easy until I got up to number 6, 'cause I knew it all. Now I need you to tell me the parts.
